result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with no critical or major visual defects. Minor issues include a truncated restaurant name and the last restaurant card being partially cut off at the bottom of the viewport.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated with an ellipsis, so the full name is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to a second line, reduce the font size, or increase the card width to display the full restaurant name.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (pizza image with '-20%' badge) is cut off at the bottom edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable area so the last card is fully visible above the bottom navigation bar, or confirm the cutoff is intended to indicate scrolling.
